results.title: Multimodal perishable fruits and vegetables dataset
results.description: There is a growing need in the agricultural industry for non-invasive methods to classify the freshness and quality of produce. To address this, we developed a multimodal dataset comprising six commonly exported fruits and vegetables from India: guava, carrot, tomato, Indian gooseberry, banana, and mango.
